tasks.label: Extract CV document text locally
args: const fs=require('fs'),z=require('zlib');const p='C:\\Users\\Devcrackpy\\Desktop\\Society . E X E\\Akire&Dev\\Ahiezer Rada - CV 2026.docx';const b=fs.readFileSync(p);let e=-1;for(let i=b.length-22;i>=Math.max(0,b.length-65558);i--){if(b.readUInt32LE(i)===0x06054b50){e=i;break}}if(e<0)throw Error('ZIP directory not found');let n=b.readUInt16LE(e+10),o=b.readUInt32LE(e+16),xml=null;for(let j=0;j<n;j++){if(b.readUInt32LE(o)!==0x02014b50)throw Error('Bad ZIP entry');let m=b.readUInt16LE(o+10),c=b.readUInt32LE(o+20),nl=b.readUInt16LE(o+28),xl=b.readUInt16LE(o+30),cl=b.readUInt16LE(o+32),lo=b.readUInt32LE(o+42),name=b.toString('utf8',o+46,o+46+nl);if(name==='word/document.xml'){let ln=b.readUInt16LE(lo+26),lx=b.readUInt16LE(lo+28),s=lo+30+ln+lx,d=b.subarray(s,s+c);xml=m===8?z.inflateRawSync(d).toString('utf8'):d.toString('utf8');break}o+=46+nl+xl+cl}if(!xml)throw Error('document.xml missing');let text=xml.replace(/<w:tab[^>]*\/>/g,'\t').replace(/<w:br[^>]*\/>/g,'\n').replace(/<\/w:p>/g,'\n').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/'/g,"'");console.log(text)
